title: Why Is There Thunder?
hook: Thunder is a sound, not a monster.
narration: Thunder is a sound, not a monster.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Is There Thunder.
Lightning heats air so fast the air jumps.
Let me show you that in 3D.
That jump makes a boom we call thunder.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
If you hear thunder, go inside and stay safe.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Thunder is a sound, not a monster.
The pictures today are a new cloud world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why is there thunder.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
